summary: Production-grade animations, spring physics, layout transitions, and gesture feedback using Motion (formerly Framer Motion) at motion.dev.

whenToUse: Use when adding animations to React apps with the motion library (formerly Framer Motion): springs, exit animations, shared layout transitions and gestures.
